name: com.gamecore.gameplay.world
description: Catalog row 2 of the gameplay plugin library (P1.1): regions, portals and streaming. Authoring: RegionDefinition, PortalDefinition, WorldDefinition, AuthoredRegion, RegionBounds and the RegionPortal trigger. Kernel half: one composition scope per region under the world scope, the world.residency/visits region slots and the world.region/posX/posY/posZ/yaw entity slots, the world.travel, host-only world.setResidency and world.place routes, and the RegionEntered/RegionLeft events. Runtime: WorldBuilder (application definition from the baked RegionManifest; every authored entity becomes a target), RegionStreamer (additive scene streaming with residency 0..3, neighbour preload, view suspension, IResidencyQuery), EntitySpawner and the presentation frame. Editor: world.connectRegions, world.addPortal and world.setSpawnPoint.
